nodes.label: Discrete INFERRED confidence rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; production data showed a bimodal collapse (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) when a continuous range was offered, so INFERRED edges must pick exactly one of five fixed values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) or be marked AMBIGUOUS instead of defaulting low.

nodes.label: Full-path node ID format requirement
nodes.rationale: Node IDs must use the full repo-relative path (every directory segment), not just the filename or immediate parent, so same-named files in different directories stay distinct and the semantic extractor's IDs match the AST extractor's IDs exactly; mismatched formats create orphan ghost-duplicate nodes.
